description: Use this when someone asks whether a company publishes its data sheets on ProofPass, or needs a manufacturer's ProofPass page or slug. Finds checked manufacturers on ProofPass by name and returns the address of their public page and their slug (for list_manufacturer_documents and search_products). Only manufacturers that are checked, not paused and have at least one current document. Do not use to look up company details, addresses, phone numbers or headquarters in general; only checked manufacturers on ProofPass are found.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

limit.description: At most this many results, 1 to 20. Default 10

name.description: Manufacturer or brand name, or part of it, e.g. "Muster"

name: find_manufacturer
title: Find a manufacturer page
